description: Image Description: The image depicts a well-lit, modern bathroom with a serene and clean aesthetic. The walls are covered in large, light beige tiles with subtle brown decorative borders running horizontally near the base. A white bathtub is positioned in the foreground, occupying the lower portion of the frame, suggesting it is centrally located in the room. Above the tub, a tall rectangular window with horizontal blinds allows natural light to filter in, offering a view of an outdoor area with greenery and a glass railing,
